paragraphs.text: Silvos , Rogue Elemental , is a fungal Thallid -like Elemental who was active in the Pre-Mending era of Dominara as a pit-fighter .

Silvos is an Elemental born of the Mirari that was thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. After gaining awareness, he found himself without purpose or meaning. Eventually, he found both in the pits, becoming a notable pit-fighter in the Grand Coliseum of Otaria .
